in_sanskrit.name: Pream
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Beginning, Intro
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pream एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Pream means the beginning, the intro, or the preamble to something. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pra-' meaning before, and 'man' meaning mind, thought, or speech. In Hindu mythology, the god Brahma is often depicted as creating the universe from the sound of his own mantra, the primal sound of creation. Thus, the name Pream symbolizes the creative power of speech and the intellect.
